info.bio:
Elizabeth Caroline Orton, Beth Orton (Norfolk, 14 de diciembre de 1970) cantautora inglesa de música folk y electrónica.

Se trasladó al Este de Londres con 14 años. Empezó en la música con Chemical Brothers y William Orbit. Más tarde también colaboraría con Beck en Midnite Vultures.

Su disco de début, Superpinkymandy, es hoy dificilísimo de encontrar y sólo se sacó en Japón. Parte del repertorio aparece en Trailer Park, de Heavenly Records en 1996

scenes.name: Cantautoras de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Las mujeres tienen sus propios estilos, en plural: Azalia Snail y su psicodelia lo-fi, Jarboe, Lida Husik (entre la cantante pop y la pintora sonora), Robin Holcomb, Lisa Germano (Geek The Girl, «un viaje dantesco a la psique de una chica»), Tori Amos, Juliana Hatfield, Kristin Hersh, Jewel, Natalie Merchant, Cat Power (Moon Pix), Edith Frost, Lauryn Hill, Shannon Wright. Las «grrrls» más airadas: Lois Maffeo, Ani DiFranco, PJ Harvey (Dry, Rid Of Me), Liz Phair (Exile In Guyville), DQE, Aimee Mann, Sheryl Crow, Alanis Morissette, Neko Case. Y los paisajes sonoros de Björk, la cantautora más influyente de la década, Kate St John, Natacha Atlas, Heather Duby, Solex y Beth Orton.

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …that her compositions ware actually "songs", and even "melodic" ones. Her silky voice blended naturally with the frigid textures of her collages. Beth Orton's Central Reservation (1999) bridged Lida Husik's ethereal style and Bjork's orchestral pop. • 1993: Jiang Zemin is appointed president of China •…

podcast.title: Crohn's Disease Diagnosis (Age 17)
podcast.body: British musician Beth Orton has been dealing with Crohn's disease since she was 17. This degenerative illness of the stomach and elementary canal involves chronic inflammation of the intestinal walls, has no known cause, and currently no cure. "She's been dealing with Crohn since she was 17. Beth has had to run off stage in the middle of a show because the cramping is too painful."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Johnny Marr's Collaboration
podcast.body: Johnny Marr worked with Beth Orton as a session guitarist after The Smiths' breakup. "He worked with Beth Orton and Neil Finn and Paul McCartney and the talking heads."

podcast.title: On-Stage Interruptions Due to Crohn's
podcast.body: Beth Orton's Crohn's disease has caused such severe cramping that she has been forced to run off stage in the middle of live performances. "Beth has had to run off stage in the middle of a show because the cramping is too painful."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Suffering from Seizures
podcast.body: In addition to Crohn's, Beth Orton also suffers from seizures, sometimes experiencing many episodes in a single day. Her seizures can be managed with steroids like prednisone and anti-epilepsy drugs. "She's also suffered from seizures sometimes many times in a day. Stereoids like prednisone can help and drugs meant for epilepsy can make the seizures go away."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Post-Smiths Career as Session Guitarist
xref.body: After The Smiths' breakup, Johnny Marr became a highly sought-after session guitarist. He worked and toured with The Pretenders and Dada, and later co-founded Electronic with Barney Sumner of New Order. He also became a friend and confidante of Noel Gallagher of Oasis, collaborating with him in the studio, and worked with artists like Beth Orton, Neil Finn, Paul McCartney, and Talking Heads. "Meanwhile, Johnny Mar became a very hot session guitarist, working in touring with the pretenders in Dada."
